blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Detecting emotions is necessary for building systems that can accurately and adaptively interact with humans. Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) has become an important research focus to develop intelligent spoken interfaces. However, most studies predict emotions at the utterance level, ignoring the conversational context, along with the emotional flow and speaker interactions it carries. In this paper, we introduce ACERT (Averaged Contextual Emotion Representation through Time), a module that integrates a flexible-length window of conversational context to better capture emotional evolution in spoken interactions. To evaluate the robustness of this method, we conducted experiments on datasets spanning diverse emotionally expressive styles and contexts. ACERT outperforms current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on IEMOCAP, establishes the first context-aware benchmark on SAFE, and obtains strong results on MELD for unweighted, class-balanced metrics. Ablation studies show that ACERT’s gains come from emotional and conversational continuity, rather than from speaker identity or acoustic conditions.
blocks.zh: 探测情绪对于构建能够准确和适应地与人类互动的系统是必要的. 语音情感识别(SER)已经成为开发智能语音界面的重要研究焦点. 然而,大多数研究预测情绪在语音层面,忽略了对话的背景,以及它带来的情绪流和扬声器互动. 在本文中,我们引入了ACERT(Averaged Control Elemental Presentation of Time),这个模块融合了一段灵活的长的谈话背景窗口,以更好地捕捉口语互动中的情感演化. 为了评价这一方法的稳健性,我们实验了跨越不同情感表达风格和背景的数据集。 ACERT在IEMOCAP上的表现优于目前最先进的(SOTA)方法,建立了第一个关于SAFE的上下文认识基准,并且对于未加权的,阶级平衡的度量衡,在MELD上取得了强劲的结果. 校对研究显示,ACERT的好处来自于情感和对话的连续性,而不是演讲者身份或声学条件.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Natural human interaction requires adaptive strategies that dynamically link past and present conversational elements, anticipate interlocutors’ reactions, and integrate multi-level inputs, from acoustic cues to complex emotional states. Humans excel at this adaptability, underpinned by several foundational cognitive frameworks such as Theory of Mind, concerned with the anticipation of others’ mental states and emotional responses [ 1 ] , pragmatic inference to detect implicatures [ 2 ] , or socio-cultural norms as filters for emotion expression [ 3 ] . In contrast, current computational models for Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) predominantly rely on statistical patterns and probabilistic predictions, often failing to capture the depth and contextual fluidity of human understanding. Our goal is to build models that use conversational context to predict upcoming emotional states for more adaptive responses, and maintain high performance across diverse interactional contexts.
blocks.zh: 自然的人类互动需要适应性策略,这些策略能动态地将过去和现在的对话要素联系起来,预测对话者的反应,并整合多层次的投入,从声调提示到复杂的情绪状态。 人类在这种适应性方面表现突出,其基础是若干基本认知框架,如“心灵理论”,关注对他人精神状态和情绪反应的预期[1],发现牵连[2]的务实推论,或作为情感表达过滤器的社会文化规范[3]。 相比之下,当前语音情感识别(SER)的计算模型主要依靠统计规律和概率预测,往往无法捕捉人类理解的深度和背景流动性. 我们的目标是建立模型,利用对话的背景来预测即将到来的情绪状态,以便做出更适应性的反应,并保持不同互动背景下的高性能.

blocks.en: With the emergence of the Transformer architecture [ 4 ] , the field of SER has recently transitioned from hand-crafted acoustic features to deep learning representations. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models such as wav2vec 2.0 [ 5 ] , HuBERT [ 6 ] , and WavLM [ 7 ] have set new baselines by extracting rich features from raw audio that capture both content and prosody [ 8 ] . To further specialize these architectures, recent works have focused on emotional adaptation. For instance, emotion2vec [ 9 ] utilizes self-supervised online distillation on unlabeled emotional data, while ExHuBERT [ 10 ] enhances the HuBERT backbone through layer duplication and fine-tuning on emotionally rich datasets, ensuring adaptability for affective tasks.
blocks.zh: 随着变形器架构的出现[4],SER领域最近从手工的声学特征过渡到了深层的学习表现. 自导自演的学习(SSL)模式,如wav2vec 2.0 [5],HuBERT [6],WavLM [7],通过从原始音频中提取内容和prosody[8]的丰富特征,设定了新的基线. 为了进一步专门化这些建筑,近期的作品侧重于情感适应. 例如,情感2vec[9]在无标签的情感数据上利用自我监督的在线蒸馏,而ExHuBERT[10]则通过层层重复和对情感丰富的数据集进行微调,增强HuBERT主干线,确保适应感动任务.

blocks.en: Using these SSL models, recent works extract structural nuances of speech through diverse strategies. Some approaches prioritize hierarchical modeling, such as SpeechFormer++ [ 11 ] and MSTR [ 12 ] , which mimic the relationship between frames, phones, and words to balance fine and coarse-grained information. Others focus on temporal dynamics at the utterance level. DWFormer [ 13 ] uses dynamic window splitting to capture local importance, while [ 14 ] employ Neural Controlled Differential Equations to model high-dimensional time-series features. To ensure that the captured signal is purely affective, DTNet [ 15 ] introduces an identity-aware module to disentangle emotional features from speaker-specific acoustic traits.
blocks.zh: 使用这些SSL模型,近期的作品通过不同的策略来提取语音的结构细微差别. 一些方法优先考虑分级建模,如SpeechFormer++[11]和MSTR[12],它们模仿了帧,手机,以及平衡精细和粗细信息的语言之间的关系. 另一些国家则注重言论层面的时间动态。 DWFormer [13] 使用动态窗口分割来捕捉局部重要性,而 [14] 则使用神经控制的不同方程式来模拟高维时间序列特征. 为确保所捕获的信号是纯感性的,DTNet[15]引入了身份意识模块,将情绪特征与扬声器特有的声学特征区分开来.

blocks.en: The majority of SER datasets contain isolated or read utterances [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] . Thus, most SER approaches still predict emotions at the utterance level, not taking into account the intra and inter-speaker emotional dynamics inherent in dialogue. To address this, some multimodal works like [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] attempt to model intra and inter-speaker emotional influences. Among audio-based approaches, CHAN [ 24 ] uses the immediately preceding utterance from the speaker and their interlocutor in a dyadic setting, and ESA CRF [ 25 ] models transitions between consecutive utterance-level emotions. However, these approaches remain limited. CHAN restricts context to a single preceding utterance, while ESA CRF operates on the sequence of utterance-level predictions rather than on the underlying audio representations. Multimodal approaches require textual or multi-speaker information that is not always available.
blocks.zh: 大部分SER数据集包含孤立或读音[16,17,18,19,20]. 因此,大多数SER方法仍然在言论层面预测情绪,没有考虑到对话固有的内在和语言间情感动态。 为了解决这一问题,一些多式联运的作品,如[21、22、23]试图模拟演讲者内部和相互之间的情感影响。 在基于音频的方法中,CHAN [24] 使用发言者及其对话者刚才在混音环境中的发言,以及欧空局的通用报告格式[25]模式在连续的语音层面情绪之间的过渡。 然而,这些办法仍然有限。 CHAN将上下文限制在前面的单一语句上,而欧空局的通用报告格式则按语句层次的预测顺序而不是根据基本的音频表示。 多式联运办法需要并非总能得到的文字信息或多语种信息。

blocks.en: In contrast, we introduce a simple and effective method that enriches the target utterance’s audio representation with a flexible-length window of preceding context through mean pooling. This approach relies on the audio modality alone and operates regardless of the speaker. It outperforms the state of the art on IEMOCAP [ 26 ] , while establishing strong results on SAFE [ 27 ] and MELD [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 反之,我们采用了一种简单有效的方法,通过平均集合来丰富目标语音的音频表达方式,其上下文的灵活长度窗口。 这种方法仅依靠音频模式,不管发言者是谁,都会运作。 它在IEMOCAP[26]上的表现超过了最新水平,同时在SAFE[27]和MELD[28]上建立了强大的成果.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: 1. ACERT (Averaged Contextual Emotion Representation through Time): A module designed to enrich utterance representations by integrating conversational information. It aggregates the preceding context through temporal mean pooling and fuses it with the target utterance representation, bridging the gap between isolated audio analysis and dynamic dialogue. The source code for ACERT is publicly available 1 1 1 https://github.com/apeuvot/ACERT . 2. Evaluation on diverse interactional dynamics: We evaluate our approach on three datasets with distinct interactional dynamics and emotionally expressive styles: IEMOCAP (dyadic scripted or improvised dialogues), MELD (multi-party conversations from the Friends TV show), and SAFE (intense emotional interactions from movies such as thrillers).
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 1. ACERT(经过时间的经过评估的背景情感表现): 一个模块,旨在通过整合对话信息来丰富言论表达。 它通过时间平均组合来综合上述情况,并将其与目标表达方式联系起来,弥合孤立的音频分析和动态对话之间的差距。 ACERT的源代码可公开查阅 1 1 1 https://github.com/apeuvot/ACERT 。 。 。 2. 对多种互动动态的评价: 我们评价三个具有明显互动动态和情感表达风格的数据集:IEMOCAP(dyadic 脚本或即兴对话)、MELD(朋友电视剧的多方对话)和SAFE(来自电影如惊悚片的强烈情感互动)。

blocks.en: ACERT (Averaged Contextual Emotion Representation through Time): A module designed to enrich utterance representations by integrating conversational information. It aggregates the preceding context through temporal mean pooling and fuses it with the target utterance representation, bridging the gap between isolated audio analysis and dynamic dialogue. The source code for ACERT is publicly available 1 1 1 https://github.com/apeuvot/ACERT .

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: ACERT is a block that can be added on top of any feature extractor, from SSL models to other SOTA SER methods. It aggregates the conversational context through temporal mean pooling and fuses it with the target utterance’s features. The resulting context-augmented representation is then fed into a classification head.
blocks.zh: ACERT是一个块,可以从任何特性提取器的顶部添加,从SSL模型到其他SOTA SER方法. 它通过时间平均组合来综合对话背景,并将其与目标言论的特征结合。 由此产生的背景说明随后纳入叙级标题。

blocks.zh: 2.1 问题设置

blocks.en: 2.2 ACERT
blocks.zh: 2.2 东帝汶

blocks.en: Context definition. Let t ∈ ℝ + t\in\mathbb{R}^{+} denote a fixed temporal context window, defined as a hyperparameter of the system and corresponding to the duration of context alone, excluding the target utterance. For each target utterance u i u_{i} , an input audio segment x ( i ) x^{(i)} is constructed by concatenating u i u_{i} with as many preceding utterances as fit within t t seconds of context, so that the total duration of x ( i ) x^{(i)} equals the duration of u i u_{i} plus t t . If the available preceding utterances exceed t t seconds, the earliest of these context utterances is truncated to fit the context window.

blocks.en: Context design choices. To define this context design, we ran preliminary experiments comparing several configurations. Using both preceding and following context performed comparably to preceding-only context ( Table 2 ). We therefore use only preceding-utterance context, as it also avoids the latency of waiting for future utterances in a real use case. Similarly, integrating speaker-dependent context, obtained either from ground-truth speaker labels or from a speaker diarization step using k-means, demonstrated no statistically significant difference in performance compared to speaker-independent context ( Table 2 ). We therefore include context regardless of the speaker, which also avoids the risk of diarization errors propagating to the SER stage. As speaker information is not available in all datasets, this speaker-independent, preceding-only context design further ensures consistent evaluation across corpora.
blocks.zh: 环境设计选择。 为了定义这种上下文设计,我们进行了初步的实验,比较了几种配置. 使用前后两种上下文的情况可与以前的情况相比较(表2)。 因此,我们只使用先发制人的背景,因为它也避免了在真正使用的情况下等待未来言论的暂时性。 同样,综合依赖发言者的语境,无论是从地面真实发言者的标签上还是从使用k-表示的发言者对称化步骤上获得,都表明与依赖发言者的语境相比,在业绩方面没有统计上的重大差别(表2)。 因此,无论发言者是谁,我们都要列入背景,这也避免了传播到塞尔维埃阶段的差错。 由于所有数据集中都没有发言者的信息,这种独立发言的、仅限上下文的设计进一步确保了整个公司的一致评价。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: Finding real-life corpora that are freely available for use, particularly those capturing emotions in naturalistic conditions, remains a significant challenge. Most publicly available datasets are limited in terms of emotional depth or context. Our method, based on conversational context, requires datasets that include entire conversations to capture the dynamic emotional flow. To address this, we propose a preliminary evaluation using acted corpora, which, despite being scripted, offer diverse acquisition contexts and emotionally expressive styles. The selected corpora are IEMOCAP, MELD and SAFE. These corpora have almost no missing utterances guaranteeing a reliable continuity in contextual flow. Although some of these corpora provide additional modalities (e.g., text or video), ACERT only uses the audio modality.
blocks.zh: 寻找可自由使用的真人公司,特别是那些在自然条件下捕捉情绪的公司,仍然是一个重大挑战。 大多数公开的数据集在情感深度或上下文方面受到限制. 我们的方法基于对话背景,需要包含整个对话的数据集来捕捉动态的情感流. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用演技公司进行初步评估,尽管剧本被编写,但提供不同的购置背景和情感表现风格。 选定的公司是IEMOCAP、MELD和SAFE。 这些公司几乎没有漏掉的语句保证了上下文流的可靠连续性. 虽然其中一些公司提供了额外的模式(如文本或视频),但ACERT只使用音频模式.

blocks.en: The IEMOCAP corpus is widely used in SER. It consists of 12 hours of dyadic conversations performed by 10 professional actors during improvised or scripted interactions. We used the same emotion labels as most SOTA methods: happiness (merged with excitement), anger, sadness, and neutrality.
blocks.zh: IEMOCAP程序在SER中被广泛使用. 它由10名专业行为者在即兴或脚本互动中进行12小时的谈话组成。 我们使用了与大多数SOTA方法相同的情感标签:幸福(与兴奋相聚),愤怒,悲伤,以及中立.

blocks.en: MELD contains 13.7 hours of conversations from the TV show Friends . In contrast to IEMOCAP, MELD introduces multi-party dynamics characterized by an over-acted and emotionally dense style, typical of sitcoms, with numerous emotional shifts. The emotional categories are: anger, disgust, fear, joy, neutrality, sadness, and surprise.
blocks.zh: MELD包含13.7小时的电视剧"朋友"的对话. 与IEMOCAP不同,MELD引入了多党动力学,其特征是动作过度,情感密集的风格,典型的情景喜剧,有无数的情感转变. 情感分类包括:愤怒,厌恶,恐惧,欢乐,中立,悲伤,以及惊喜.

blocks.en: The Situation Analysis in a Fictional and Emotional (SAFE) corpus is designed to analyze strong emotions in extreme contexts such as natural disasters and physical or psychological threats and aggression. It was created by extracting 400 scenes from 30 different movies. It provides about 7 hours of audio with 400 different speakers. The emotional labels are: fear, other negative emotions, positive emotions, and neutrality.
blocks.zh: 虚构和情感体(SAFE)中的情况分析旨在分析自然灾害、身体或心理威胁和侵犯等极端情况下的强烈情绪。 它是通过从30部不同的电影中提取400场景来创造的. 它提供大约7小时的音频,有400个不同的演讲者. 情感标签是:恐惧,其他负面情绪,积极情绪,以及中立.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training and evaluation procedure
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训和评价程序

blocks.en: We use HuBERT-large 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/hubert-large-ll60k as the feature encoder. Models are trained using a cross-entropy loss function, a batch size of 16 and a learning rate of 1.3 × 10 − 4 1.3\times 10^{-4} . The evaluations are conducted using a context window t ∈ { 5 ​ k ∣ k ∈ { 1 , … , 8 } } t\in\{5k\mid k\in\{1,\dots,8\}\} .
blocks.zh: https://huggingface.co/facebook/hubert-large-ll60k作为特写编码器。 模型的训练使用跨内损函数,批量大小为16个,学习率为1.3×10−4 1.3\times 10×4}. 评估使用上下文窗口 t {{} 5 k } k {} { 1, ..., 8 }}\\\ 5 k\ mid k\ {} 1,\ dots, 8}} 进行。

blocks.en: For IEMOCAP and SAFE, we evaluate our method in a speaker-independent 5-fold cross-validation setting. For IEMOCAP, we use the standard evaluation method used in SOTA works (e.g., [ 13 , 8 ] ), where each test fold contains one of the 5 sessions. For SAFE each test fold consists of scenes from 6 of the 30 movies in the dataset. For MELD, we use the standard training, development, and test splits [ 11 , 13 , 12 ] . Each experiment is run 5 times.
blocks.zh: 对IEMOCAP和SAFE来说,我们是在一个5倍独立发言的交叉验证环境中评估我们的方法的. 对于IEMOCAP,我们使用SOTA作品中使用的标准评价方法(例如[13,8]),其中每个测试折叠包含5个会话中的一个. 对于SAFE,每个测试折叠由数据集中30部电影中的6部的场景组成. 对于MELD,我们使用标准训练,开发,和测试分拆[11,13,12]. 每个实验进行5次.

blocks.en: We report performance using Unweighted Accuracy (UA), Weighted Accuracy (WA), Macro-F1, and Weighted-F1 scores along with their respective standard deviations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用未加权精确度(UA),加权精确度(WA),Macro-F1和Wighted-F1的分数以及各自的标准差来报告性能.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: To test whether ACERT’s gains depend on conversational and emotional continuity, and not just on speaker identity or recording conditions, we design three ablation studies on IEMOCAP at the optimal context window t = 25 t=25\, s. In the same session, continuous context condition, the true preceding context is replaced by a continuous segment from a single other conversation in the same session (same speakers, same recording conditions), preserving turn-taking but unrelated to the target conversation. In the same session, random context condition, it is instead replaced by a random mixture of utterances from all other conversations in the same session, with no temporal or conversational continuity. Comparing these two conditions isolates the effect of the context’s continuity, independently of its relevance to the target conversation. Since both conditions control for speaker identity and recording conditions, any drop in performance can be attributed to the loss of conversational and emotional continuity. Finally, in the same conversation, shuffled order condition, the preceding context is kept but its utterances are presented in random order, isolating the effect of temporal order alone, independently of context relevance.
blocks.zh: 为了检验ACERT的收益是否取决于对话与情感的连续性,而不仅仅取决于演讲者身份或录音条件,我们在最佳上下文窗口 t = 25 t= 25\, s 上设计了三项关于IEMOCAP的消化研究. 在同一会话,连续上下文条件中,真实的上下文被同一会话中单个其他对话的连续段所取代(相同的扬声器,相同的录音条件),保留了转弯,但与目标对话无关. 在同一会话中,随机上下文条件,取而代之的是任意混合同一会话中所有其他对话的言论,没有时间或对话连续性. 比较这两个条件会孤立环境连续性的效果,而不管它与目标对话的相关性. 由于对扬声器身份和录音条件都有控制条件,所以任何性能的下降都可以归因于对话和情感连续性的丧失. 最后,在同一段谈话中,洗涤了秩序条件,保留了前一种上下文,但其语句是按随机顺序呈现的,孤立了时间秩序单独的效果,独立于上下文的相关性.

blocks.en: 4 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental results
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验结果

blocks.en: Figure 1(a) shows the results of our method on IEMOCAP. The performance improves significantly as the context window length increases before eventually reaching a plateau. This displays the effectiveness of using context rather than relying solely on the target utterance, which lasts on average 4.55 s (see Table 1 ), for prediction. Adding only t = 5 t=5\, s of context already improves UA by 8.02 points over the context-free baseline (from 68.38 % to 76.40 %), and the highest overall performance is achieved at t = 25 t=25\, s with an UA of 79.08 %, a gain of 10.70 points.
blocks.zh: 图1(a)显示了我们采用IEMOCAP方法的结果。 随着上下文窗口长度的增大,最终到达高原,性能显著改善. 这表明了使用上下文而不是仅仅依赖平均持续4.55秒的目标语句(见表1)进行预测的有效性。 只加入 t = 5 t=5\,s 上下文已经比无上下文基线提高8.02分(从68.38%提高到76.40%),实现最高的整体性能为 t = 25 t=25\,s上下文的UA为79.08%,增收10.70分.

blocks.en: As with IEMOCAP, we observe a significant increase in performance with context on the SAFE dataset ( Figure 1(b) ), peaking at t = 25 t=25\, s with a 3.99 % point gain in UA over the context-free baseline (from 41.20 % to 45.19 % UA), before declining as the context window is extended further.
blocks.zh: 与IEMOCAP一样,我们看到在SFE数据集(图1(b))上,性能显著提高,峰值为 t = 25 t = 25\,s 与无上下文基线相比,UA的点值增益为3.99%(从41.20%降至45.19% UA),然后随着上下文窗口的进一步扩大而下降。

blocks.en: In contrast, for MELD ( Figure 1(c) ) we observe no statistically significant improvement of the results when using a short context window. The reasons behind this stagnation are discussed in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 相比之下,对于MELD(图1(c))来说,在使用一个简短的上下文窗口时,我们没有观察到在统计学上对结果的重大改进。 第4.4节讨论了这种停滞的原因。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with baseline and SOTA works
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基线和SOTA工程的比较

blocks.en: Table 2 compares ACERT against the baseline and SOTA methods, with and without conversational context. For the SOTA approaches, values are taken from the original papers. For ACERT, we report the results of the experiments with the context window t t that achieved the highest UA.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了ACERT与基线和SOTA方法的对比,无论有无对话背景。 对于SOTA方法,数值取自原始论文. 对于ACERT,我们报告实现最高UA的上下文窗口 t t的实验结果.

blocks.en: On IEMOCAP, ACERT outperforms not only the context-free baseline and SOTA methods without context, but also all context-aware methods, including CHAN, the strongest context-aware baseline, by 3.18 points in UA and 2.83 points in WA.
blocks.zh: 在IEMOCAP上,ACERT的绩效不仅超过了无上下文基线和SOTA方法,而且超过了所有有上下文意识的方法,包括最强的上下文认识基线CHAN,在UA和WA的2.83点.

blocks.en: On SAFE, no prior context-aware evaluation exists but ACERT improves over the context-free baseline by 3 to 4 points across all four metrics, establishing the first context-aware benchmark on this dataset.
blocks.zh: 关于 " 安全教育 " ,没有事先对上下文作出评价,但 " ACERT " 在所有四个衡量标准上比无上下文基线提高3至4点,在这个数据集上建立了第一个上下文认识基准。

blocks.en: On MELD, ACERT matches or exceeds [ 23 ] , the other context-aware method, in UA and Macro-F1, achieving the best Macro-F1 across all methods regardless of context. It also outperforms the context-free baseline on both metrics, though it still falls below on weighted metrics.
blocks.zh: 在MELD上,ACERT匹配或超过[23],另一种上下文认知方法,在UA和Macro-F1中,无论上下文,在所有方法中实现最佳的Macro-F1. 它还超过了两个度量的无上下文基线,尽管它仍然低于加权度量。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the results of the three ablation studies described in Section 3.3 . All three perform notably worse than ACERT (69.82 %, 70.09 % and 75.87 % UA against 79.08 %), despite using context from the same speakers and recording conditions. This gap holds consistently across all four metrics. These results confirm that the improvement brought by ACERT does not simply come from the presence of additional speech of the current speakers or from matching acoustic conditions, but specifically from the conversational and emotional continuity of the context. Moreover, the two unrelated-context studies perform similarly to each other (69.82 % vs. 70.09 % UA, within one standard deviation), suggesting that once the context is unrelated to the target conversation, its continuity has little additional impact.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了第3.3节所述三项发展研究的结果。 所有这三种表现都明显比ACERT差(69.82%、70.09%和75.87%普遍获得服务,而79.08%),尽管采用了相同的讲音和录音条件。 在所有四个衡量标准中,这一差距始终存在。 这些结果证实,ACERT带来的改进不仅仅是来自当前发言者的附加发言,或者来自相匹配的音响条件,具体来说,是来自语境的谈话和情感连续性. 此外,两项无关的语境研究在一种标准偏差内,彼此的性能相似(69.82%对70.09%的UA),说明一旦上下文与目标对话无关,其连续性几乎没有额外影响.

blocks.en: Interestingly, both ablation results also remain close to the context-free baseline (68.38 % UA), which can itself be regarded as a third, more extreme ablation of ACERT providing no context at all. This indicates that an unrelated context brings almost no benefit over having no context at all, an effect we also observe for MELD in Section 4.4 . In contrast, shuffling the order of the true context gives an intermediate result (75.87 % UA), confirming that the temporal order of a relevant context also contributes to ACERT’s gains, beyond its relevance alone.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,这两种衰减结果也仍然接近无上下文基线(68.38%普遍获得率),这本身可被视为ACERT第三次更极端的衰减,完全不提供上下文. 这表明,一个无关的上下文几乎比没有上下文没有任何好处,我们在第4.4节中也观察到这一影响。 与此相反,真实背景的排列顺序给出了中间结果(75.87%的普遍获得率),确认相关背景的时间顺序也有利于ACERT的收益,而不仅仅是其相关性。

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制

blocks.en:
As shown in Section 4.1 , using conversational context fails to improve performance on the MELD dataset. Several factors may explain this finding. First, the number of speakers in each conversation: while IEMOCAP involves two easily distinguishable speakers (one male and one female), MELD averages 3.4 speakers per conversation (SAFE lacks sufficient speaker-related data for a reliable comparison). Furthermore, MELD exhibits a much lower emotional stability than IEMOCAP and SAFE ( Table 1 ), with an average same emotion duration of only 5.5 s, compared to 33.6 s for IEMOCAP and 27.5 s for SAFE.
This emotional instability, together with our IEMOCAP ablation study ( Section 4.3 ) showing that context whose emotional state differs from the target utterance provides no benefit over having no context at all, explains why extending the context window does not improve performance on MELD.
blocks.zh:
如第4.1节所示,使用对话语境无法改善MELD数据集的性能。 有几个因素可以解释这一结论。 首先,每次对话的发言者人数:虽然IEMOCAP涉及两个容易区分的发言者(一名男性和一名女性),但MELD平均每次对话有3.4名发言者(SAFE缺乏足够的与发言者有关的数据进行可靠的比较)。 此外,MELD的情感稳定性远低于IEMOCAP和SAFE(表1),平均同一情感持续时间仅为5.5秒,而IEMOCAP的情感稳定性为33.6秒,SAFE为27.5秒。
这种情绪不稳定,加上我们的IEMOCAP消化研究(第4.3节),显示其情绪状态与目标言论不同的环境与没有环境根本无济于事,这解释了为什么扩展环境窗口不能改善MELD的性能。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduces a novel module that leverages conversational context through temporal mean pooling to enrich the representation of a target utterance with information from the surrounding dialogue. Evaluated across three datasets spanning distinct interactional dynamics, ACERT largely surpasses state-of-the-art methods on IEMOCAP and achieves solid results on SAFE and MELD. Our results further show that using context is most effective when conversations are emotionally stable such as in IEMOCAP and SAFE.
blocks.zh: 本文引入了一个新的模块,通过时间平均集合利用对话的背景,用周围对话的信息丰富目标言论的表述。 对涉及不同相互作用动态的三套数据集进行评估后,ACERT在很大程度上超过了IEMOCAP的先进方法,并在SAFE和MELD上取得了扎实的成果. 我们的结果表明,当对话在情感上稳定时,例如IEMOCAP和SAFE,使用上下文最为有效。

blocks.en: Future work will explore ways to automatically detect when context is emotionally relevant to the target utterance, rather than treating all context equally, which could help on datasets with rapid emotional shifts such as MELD. It could also evaluate cross-corpus generalization, for example by training on one dataset and testing on another, to assess whether the benefit of conversational context transfers across different interactional styles.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探索各种方法,在情境与目标语句在情感上相关时自动检测,而不是平等对待所有情境,这可能有助于MELD等情绪快速变化的数据集. 它还可以通过对一个数据集进行培训和对另一个数据集进行测试等方法,评价跨公司的通用性,以评估对话背景在不同的互动风格之间转移的好处。
